findings.text: An unpaid bill is not in the accounts
No inventory for a small business
Category is a second step after entering an expense
A paid bill does not show as an expense

requirements.text: The category rides with the expense in ONE request on the API, the desktop form and mobile Capture; it is prefilled from vendor memory, books on that category (never 6999), and is learned only from a human's choice.
Every posting (expense, bill, payment, void, amend, stock) goes through one writer: balanced, closed-period gate in UTC, idempotent replay on the unique key; the legacy bill-pay route uses it too.

Tax codes per jurisdiction (AU GST/CAP/FRE/INP/NTR, CA GST/HST/PST/QST/zero/exempt, US sales tax) with golden values (AU $110 → $10, $0.99 → $0.09, CA per-component rounding, meals 50%), rates from the existing providers only.
Registrants post recoverable tax to 2100 and the net to the category; non-registered tenants and the US post gross with no tax row; unknown registration posts gross and prompts.
A tax-typed expense can be edited, recategorised, deleted and reclassified out of suspense, each leaving balanced books and correct P&L figures.
AU BAS 1B/G10/G11 and the CA ITC come from line data (legacy rows fall back as today); AU cash-basis GST counts bills by payment date pro-rata.
One deductible figure: every table reader (deductions, category and vendor reports) uses deductibleCents, guarded against direct amountCents use.
Tax is prefilled and entered in the same confirm on capture, the web form and chat ("$110 incl GST"); OCR keeps the printed tax and flags a >2¢ mismatch; strings in en/fr-CA/zh-CN.
Legacy gross rows are never silently reinterpreted: restatement is opt-in per tax year with a preview, done by amend-reversal + repost, skips closed periods, and is a no-op the second time.
Bill schema evolves additively (lines, payments, postingMode, partial/draft) and bills, lines, payments, employees, pay runs and stubs are in the tenant export and deletion registry.
A bill entered unpaid is on the books on its bill date: DR expense / inventory / 2100, CR 2000 AP, for accrual tenants.
Paying a bill (in full or in part) moves AP to cash and never creates a second expense; overpayment is refused; concurrent payments cannot overpay.
Existing bills and cash-basis tenants keep working exactly as before (pay-time posting), now with a period gate, a real sourceId and no silent fallback account.
AP is never double-counted: every reader treats open|partial as unpaid, the balance sheet balances for mixed legacy/new bills and counts no bill twice.
A cash-basis view never silently loses a bill's cost: ?basis=cash is disabled with a banner while open at-entry bills exist.
A paid bill is visible in the Expenses/Docs list (one row per bill with a Due/Paid badge) without being an expense row.
Bills are usable everywhere: web Bills page with aging, mobile Capture "Pay later", chat record/pay/query, and a bank debit for a bill records a payment, not an expense; strings in en/fr-CA/zh-CN.

An employee profile can be viewed and edited, incl. the market's tax, bank and super/benefit fields (TFN/residency/super, SIN/TD1, W-4); unknown keys rejected; edits apply from the next draft run only.

TFN/SIN/SSN, bank and super member numbers are encrypted (fail closed without a key), masked in every response and export, absent from logs/chat/search/error reports; reveal is audited, rate-limited and owner-only.
Pay frequency is visible and editable with market labels (Fortnightly in AU, Bi-weekly in US/CA, in all three locales and chat) and drives draft pay-run dates per frequency group.
Statutory reports (STP, BAS W1/W2, W-2/T4/payment summaries, deposits) bucket by pay date across quarter and year boundaries; the payroll journal stays on period end.
Employee and pay-frequency questions and edits work in chat, passing the chat parity guard.
Opt-in inventory: items, purchases via bill lines debit 1500 and add on-hand qty/value in integer cents (weighted average), opening stock balances to 3900, low-stock alert.
A sale relieves stock at weighted-average cost to the market's COGS account (5990 US/CA, 5000 AU) once per invoice line; void restores; on-hand value is exactly 0 at qty 0; COGS-by-period report.
A full journal property test (bills, payments, voids, tax, inventory, payroll entries) keeps Σdr = Σcr and AP = Σ open bills in CI.
Docs (architecture, product, workflows, user stories) describe the shipped programme.
